title: General Settings
description: Manage basic information, branding, and website metadata

general.title: General
general.desc: Default settings for the system and users

branding.title: Branding
branding.desc: Logo and favicon displayed in browser, emails, and public pages

logo.label: Main Logo
logo.hint: Format: PNG, SVG or JPG. Recommended: 200×60px

siteName.label: Website Name
siteName.desc: Displayed in page title, header, and emails

slogan.label: Slogan
slogan.placeholder: Example: Building the future with technology

metadata.title: Metadata & SEO
metadata.desc: Information to help search engines and improve link preview when shared

description.label: Website Description
description.placeholder: A short description of your platform...
description.desc: Used for meta description, maximum 160 characters

keywords.label: Keywords
keywords.desc: Separated by commas, supports basic SEO

ogImage.label: OG Image URL
ogImage.desc: Image displayed when sharing links on social media (recommended 1200×630px)

additional.title: Additional Information
additional.desc: Default settings for the system and users

notifications.title: Notification Settings
notifications.description: Configure email and Zalo OA channels for the system to send notifications to users

smtp.title: SMTP Configuration
smtp.desc: Used to send transactional emails, notifications, password resets, etc.

fromEmail.label: From Email
fromEmail.desc: The email address shown to recipients (should verify domain)

zaloOA.title: Zalo Official Account (ZNS / OA Messages)
zaloOA.desc: Send Zalo notifications to Vietnamese users (ZNS is very effective)

help.title: How to Get Access Token
help.desc: Go to Zalo Developers → Official Account → API → OA Access Token

token.label: OA Access Token
token.desc: Token used to send messages via Zalo OA API

oaId.label: OA ID
oaId.desc: ID of the Official Account (usually starts with 24xxxx)

enableZalo.label: Enable notifications via Zalo OA
enableZalo.desc: Allow the system to use Zalo to send ZNS or OA messages
